text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm filling out some paperwork when
Mayano Top
Gun's homeroom teacher
informs me that she
didn't show up for
class...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a vapor trail... I bet it'd be fun to
ride one of
those...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I don't wanna go to class. It's so boring.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Racing, shopping, talking... All the
things I used
to like... They're all so
boring.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And my body's feeling heavier and
heavier...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running back-to-back races must be
taking a toll
on her. I'd better adjust her
race schedule...
